idle.description: Use when no other state is needed.

planning.system_prompt: Use deep reasoning to create or refine a step-by-step plan of actions.

action.description: Use action to follow the plan.
action.system_prompt: Take steps to follow the plan, change to review after a step is complete or if you have trouble.

review.description: Use review after an action or planning.
review.system_prompt: Analyze the outcome. Decide what to do next.

prune.description: Use prune to prevent oom by cleaning the history.
prune.system_prompt: Only use tools while in this state. Either use the 'gc' tool on stale and irrelevant messages or get out using 'set_state'.
